# Chain of title

Cyclowareness rebuilds the earlier cylosof.com portal. `docs/audit/` was extracted from that live portal, and the assets below were carried over from it unchanged or nearly so (register L-02: the scenes of all 106 English lessons are JSON-identical to the extracted originals, and `portal/public/rive/mascot.riv` is byte-identical to `docs/audit/assets/mascot.riv`). The repository holds no assignment, licence or ownership record for any of them.

For each row the owner records who made the asset, for whom they worked when they made it (employee, contractor, co-founder or the owner personally), the agreement that transfers or licenses the rights to the owner entity named in [`LICENSE`](../../LICENSE), and the file in the data room that proves it. Until a row is filled, the asset's title is unproven.

The translations of the lessons, interface and legal texts into the other nine languages were made in this repository by AI agents (`docs/build/DECISIONS.md`); they derive from the English texts below and follow their title.

## Assets other than lessons

| Asset | Location | Author | Employer or contractor | Agreement | Evidence file |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mascot (Rive file) | `portal/public/rive/mascot.riv` | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed |
| Design tokens (colours, type, radii, shadows) | `portal/src/app/globals.css` (`:root` and `@theme`) | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed |
| Landing copy | `portal/content/landing/` | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed |
| Legal texts (privacy policy, terms) | `portal/content/legal/` | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed |
| Acceptable-use policy (header cites cyclowareness.com, version 1, 03.10.2026) | `portal/content/policies/acceptable-use.*.md` | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed |
| Password policy | `portal/content/policies/passwords.*.md` | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed | evidence needed |
